_comment: E10.1 exact original two-model CPU/cublas/fixed reference gate; no engine default change; full inventory and numerical gate fail closed.

jobs.name: e10_fixed
cmd: set -eu; out="$1"; mkdir -p "$out"; for f in ember.tgz pick.gguf pk.gguf eval100.jsonl COMMITS fixed_reference_vm.sh INPUT_SHA256SUMS; do cp "/content/chat/upload/$f" "/content/$f"; done; rc=0; bash /content/fixed_reference_vm.sh || rc=$?; cp /content/vm.log "$out/vm.log"; if [ -s /content/out.zip ]; then cp /content/out.zip "$out/out.zip"; fi; if [ -s /content/out/gate_summary.json ]; then cp /content/out/gate_summary.json "$out/gate_summary.json"; fi; exit "$rc"
